title: Attention Is All You Need for Chinese Word Segmentation
answer_short: Gaussian-masked directional multi-head attention is a variant of scaled dot-product attention that applies a Gaussian mask to weight attention based on character distance and uses multi-head architecture to capture information from different dimensions.
answer_rationale: The mechanism combines directional masking with Gaussian weights based on distance (blocks 2, 5, 6) and multi-head attention (blocks 7, 8) to enhance localness and directional information capture in Chinese word segmentation.
